steps.title: Sign in
steps.note: Every role signs in on the same page; the role decides what they see.

steps.title: Customer dashboard
steps.note: The customer sees only their own complaints, statuses and messages.

steps.title: Complaint wizard: details
steps.note: Title, description (minimum 20 characters), product and order number. The order number format is checked as you type.

steps.title: Complaint wizard: context and attachments
steps.note: Requested resolution, incident date and three supporting files: invoice (PDF), photo (JPG) and delivery note (DOCX).

steps.title: Complaint wizard: review
steps.note: The customer checks everything, including the 3 attachments, before submitting.

steps.title: Submitted: CMP-00009
steps.note: Status, department and the latest update are shown in plain language. Attachments are listed under Supporting documents.

steps.title: Customer opens an attachment
steps.note: Clicking a file opens it in a preview (images and PDFs inline); Download saves it. Only the complaint owner and staff can fetch it.

steps.title: Customer asks Nova
steps.note: Nova answers from the customer's own complaints and approved policies only.

steps.title: Agent dashboard
steps.note: Unassigned and own cases, SLA risk and escalations at a glance.

steps.title: Complaint list with filters
steps.note: Filters run in SQL: category, department, priority, urgency, sentiment, escalation, SLA risk, review, dates.

steps.title: Complaint before analysis
steps.note: The agent sees the untrusted original text, metadata and the attachments.

steps.title: Analysis result: both pipelines
steps.note: Pipeline 2 (Python rules) is the ground truth; Pipeline 1 (GenAI) drafted in parallel. Took 29s.

steps.title: Eligibility against policy conditions
steps.note: Replacement window, product condition and previous replacements are checked from facts, including the invoice date.

steps.title: Attachment evidence
steps.note: Order number, amount and purchase date read from the invoice; the photo counts as photo evidence. All of it fed both pipelines.

steps.title: Validation controls and policy precedence
steps.note: Every flag Python raised, and which policy governs over FAQs or older versions.

steps.title: GenAI vs Python, field by field
steps.note: Mismatches lower the verification score and send the case to manual review.

steps.title: Draft reply and guidance
steps.note: GenAI draft reply, clarification questions, and Python's mandatory and prohibited actions.

steps.title: Structured JSON
steps.note: The exact schema-validated output of both pipelines, stored with provider, model and prompt version.

steps.title: Unsafe reply blocked
steps.note: The promise guard stops replies that promise a replacement, a voucher or a timeline the policy does not support. Agents cannot override it.

steps.title: Policy-safe reply sent
steps.note: The reply passes the guard and reaches the customer. The first-response SLA is recorded.

steps.title: Customer sees the reply and answers
steps.note: Messages come from "NimbusCarta Support"; internal notes never show here.

steps.title: Manual review queue
steps.note: Why the case needs a human, and the GenAI recommendation next to the Python ground truth.

steps.title: Reviewer approves
steps.note: The decision and the original recommendation are both kept in the audit trail.

steps.title: Agent resolves the case
steps.note: The update note becomes the customer's latest update, and a resolution-confirmation follow-up is scheduled.

steps.title: Did this resolve your issue?
steps.note: The customer confirms or reopens with a reason.

steps.title: Closed with a 5-star rating
steps.note: CSAT is stored and appears on the Reports page.

steps.title: Audit trail
steps.note: Every action, by whom and when, plus GenAI runs with provider, model, prompt version and retries.

steps.title: Reports and analytics
steps.note: Volume trend, categories, departments, products, sentiment, SLA, CSAT and exports.

steps.title: Evaluation workbench
steps.note: Upload a hidden complaint pack and score both pipelines against expected labels.

steps.title: Knowledge base
steps.note: Versioned policies, SOPs and FAQs, parsed into traceable sections.

steps.title: Settings: pipelines
steps.note: Provider chain (incl. Ollama), prompt version, thresholds, rules, SLA and users, all editable without code.

agent_guidance: Verify the order details and invoice
Check the delivery note for any damage
Request a photo of the damaged product and packaging
Review the policy excerpt for Damaged on Arrival
Assess the claim within 5 business days
Request a replacement if the product is damaged on arrival
genai.escalation_notes: Tablet arrived with a cracked screen. Customer provided photo and invoice. The tablet works but the touch screen does not respond in the cracked area. The order was delivered two days ago and the box corner was dented.
resolution_steps: Verify the order details and invoice
Check the delivery note for any damage
Request a photo of the damaged product and packaging
Review the policy excerpt for Damaged on Arrival
Assess the claim within 5 business days
Request a replacement if the product is damaged on arrival
genai.complaint_summary: Customer received a damaged NimbusTab 11 tablet with a cracked screen. The tablet works but the touch screen does not respond in the cracked area. The order was delivered two days ago and the box corner was dented.
genai.customer_response: Dear customer, we understand your concern about the damaged tablet. We have received your invoice, photo, and delivery note. We will review the policy and take the necessary steps to resolve this issue. The replacement will be processed as soon as possible.
genai.escalation_reason: Damaged product on arrival, need verification and replacement
clarification_questions: Can you provide the serial number of the tablet?
Is there any other damage to the tablet besides the cracked screen?
Can you confirm that the tablet was delivered to the correct address?
genai.follow_up_communication: Dear customer, we have reviewed the policy and have requested a replacement for your damaged tablet. We will provide an update on the status of your request shortly.

items.note: Photo evidence. Image content is not machine-read; view it before deciding.

final.title: Tablet arrived with a cracked screen
final.description: My NimbusTab 11 was delivered two days ago with the screen cracked across the middle. The box corner was dented and the courier noted it on the delivery note. The tablet turns on but the touch screen does not respond in the cracked area. I have attached the invoice, a photo and the delivery note.
final.latest_update: Thank you for confirming. Your complaint is closed.
